title: Active Preference Optimization for Sample Efficient RLHF
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic sample efficiency in RLHF using active learning and contextual dueling bandits. Although it uses the Anthropic-HH (Helpful and Harmless) dataset for empirical validation, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves; rather, it measures the mathematical performance and convergence of its sampling strategy.
